purpose: S6 darkening diagnostic (docs/TRACK_C_GI.md 'S6 darkening'): is the m4p3 step darkening gi_hit_direct or the forge's animated lava? Every variant compiled in warmup (no DXC stall before a shot, unlike m4p3); one replay pack of the gi_hit_direct base variant (diag-pack, rt_stats: the GI hit direct line with the non-finite counters) for the offline invariant (py -3 -m tools.gi_hit_invariant --pack <dir>: giRaw.a bit-equal, mean hit >= base); five OFF and four gi_hit_direct shots interleaved (each ON bracketed by two OFF: linear drift cancels); gi_debug=3 (visibility only) and gi_debug=2 (the GI's added diffuse only) pairs. Startup: rt_hit_material=1, rt_cascade_casters=0 and rt_hit_material_instanced=0 (the pack contract's base variant, no defines), rt_emissive=0. replay_pack_cap_mb=3300 as rc1 (needs the user's approval for this job too). No post step: the S8 pack stays (replay_capture's post step would delete every older pack).
